Quick pass on head 13a1f2625d88cd4a378ad92d78dfef62471e00c6: the PR stays a draft. Missing items:
- The quick gate is not green on this head. The body reports 2 failed app tests: `setup_align::unverified_kinds_are_refused_while_verified_picks_generate_aligned` and `stitch_cross::a_self_touching_single_body_still_stops_at_its_top_level`. Run the gate again on a head that has the current main, and show that both tests pass or are fixed.
- The body says "Stacked on #1935". PR #1935 is merged and the base is main now. Remove or correct that line.

Review fix on head `6bbed21715b726e96ac39430b945e15e72bdc89f`:
- I merged `origin/main` into the branch (no rebase, no force-push). The merge had no conflicts.
- The 2 red app tests now pass: `setup_align::unverified_kinds_are_refused_while_verified_picks_generate_aligned` and `stitch_cross::a_self_touching_single_body_still_stops_at_its_top_level`. The old head had an earlier #1935 head as its base. The last #1935 commit `72c8f293d` on main updated these 2 tests and `contour_depth.rs`. No code or assert of this PR changed.
- Pinning binaries pass: `setup_align` 10, `stitch_cross` 6, `contour_auto_level` 3, `area_open` 11, `contour_outside_hole` 5, `operations` 120 (6 ignored), `contour_auto_side` 6. Clippy on `camcraft-app` and `camcraft-motion` is clean.
- The body no longer says "Stacked on #1935". The base is `main`.
- Not run on the new head: the full quick gate (other motion, ui and post suites).
The PR stays a draft.

Quick pass on head 6bbed21715b726e96ac39430b945e15e72bdc89f: the PR merges cleanly with main; the targeted gate is green on this head (`setup_align`, `stitch_cross`, `contour_auto_level`, `area_open`, `contour_outside_hole`, `operations`, `contour_auto_side`, clippy on `camcraft-app` and `camcraft-motion`); the body is complete. The full quick tier did not run on this head, and the body says so. The PR is ready for the independent review.

Independent review of head 6bbed21715b726e96ac39430b945e15e72bdc89f. I built and tested it in a review worktree. The trial merge with main (31f8d03d7) took no conflicts and no hand edits.

**What I ran (debug, on the merged tree):**

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --lib` | pass 386, ignored 6 |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test contour_auto_side` | pass 6 |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test machining2d` | pass 66 |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --lib` | pass 333, ignored 1 |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test contour_auto_level` | pass 3 |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test area_open` | pass 11 |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test contour_outside_hole` | pass 5 |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test operations` | pass 120, ignored 6 |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test setup_align` | pass 10 |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test stitch_cross` | pass 6 |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

Not run: the ui suites, the post suites, and the other motion suites. The diff touches no file of those crates; the gate maps reach the ui suites only through app::operation. The batch gate on main covers them. The ignored heavy lanes, the pixel snapshots and the GUI stayed out of scope.

**What I checked (safety floor):**

- The law `machining2d::auto_side` (`crates/motion/src/machining2d/contour_auto.rs`) never guesses. It answers Inside, Outside, or Undecided with a sentence that names the Z level and asks for a named side. `generate.rs` turns an Undecided verdict into a refusal by name. I traced every probe pairing in the match: both arms that can return a side are the two "one side only" readings; both probes disagreeing, and material on both sides without a decision, reach `Undecided`.
- The refusal blocks the post. It cannot pass silently: the downstream #1927 containment and gouge laws also refuse a bad side, so a wrong Auto gives a visible refusal, not a gouge.
- Plasma and wire contours do not use the verdict. Their arms drop the third tuple slot (`generate.rs` lines 123 and 138), and the level law gate in `selection_geometry_impl` matches only `OpParams::Contour` with Side Auto.
- Degenerate input gives an answer or a clean `GenError`, not a crash: empty facets, empty rings, non-finite pick Z, and a failed ring offset are all handled. No unwrap, expect or panic outside tests in the new code.
- Provenance lines are present in both new modules and in the new test files. The decision entry `docs/decisions/1933-contour-auto-side-level.md` states the law, the reason, the dropped options and one known limit.
- The tests pin all four "Done means" items of #1933: the blind bore rim resolves Inside and cuts to the floor Z 4.000 with the centre one tool radius inside the wall and 0 gouges; the through hole resolves Inside; the boss and the outer wall resolve Outside; the `area_open` assert now names the clean Inside pass in place of the old refusal.
- The commit bodies carry the issue keyword and the subject follows the commit format. The body carries its `Changelog:` line. The PR changes no snapshot PNG and no process file.

**Findings (no blocker):**

- The panel note for Side Auto has no tilted frame: `contour_auto_side` runs the walk with `frame` set to `None` (`selection.rs`), while generation reads the frame's local axis (`contour_auto_pick.rs`). Under a tilted frame the note can quote a side that a later generate refuses. Output stays safe. The body already names this gap as untested. It merits a `source:agent` follow-up row, not rework here.
- `material_region.rs:60` reads `.unwrap_or(false)`: with no verdict the area preview draws the Outside side. The preview can outline a pass that generate refuses. The same shape exists before this PR, so it is a note for a later fix, not a blocker.

**Verdict: merge-ready.** Clean review, clean build, green suites above, and a clean trial merge with main. A `fix:` PR merges when reviewed.
